items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: like they used to talk about Joe Oliver and Johnny St.Cyr.

ctx.x: Now, when you worked with Jelly Roll, was he already a name known to you when you went in?

No. Not really. I'd probably heard his name, but he didn't -- I mean the name didn't mean too much to me at that time. I was just discovering all these people and this music, I just discovered, you know, what it meant and what they were playing, because at that time I was more steeped in what was happening right here in New York, and as I discovered these people -- you know, like it was -- mostly what happened was, you know, like you say, the musicians' club, you know, all these older musicians, they sit around…
Well, they weren't really that old then.
